01c6123adb67.name: Wraith Form
01c6123adb67.plain: Each model in this unit has a 4+ invulnerable save. Also, whenever this unit makes a Normal Move, Advances, Falls Back or makes a charge move, its models can pass horizontally through other models and terrain features until that move ends, but they can't end the move on top of another model or its base.

03453726a677.name: Fractal Targeting
03453726a677.plain: In your Shooting phase: pick one of your TOMB BLADES units. Until the phase ends, the Rapid Fire weapons its models carry count as Assault 2 weapons, and its models ignore the hit roll penalty for shooting Assault weapons in a turn when their unit Advanced.

03befb49e557.name: Enslaved Protectors
03befb49e557.plain: In your opponent's Charge phase: pick one of your CANOPTEK units. Until the phase ends, it can perform Heroic Interventions as though it were a CHARACTER.

05aacd962e1b.name: Matter Absorption
05aacd962e1b.plain: At the end of every phase, roll a D6 for each enemy VEHICLE model that this model destroyed that phase, either with an attack or with one of its C'tan Powers. For every 2+, this model gets back 1 lost wound, up to a limit of 3 wounds regained per phase.

089c6a330cda.name: Eternal Protectors
089c6a330cda.plain: In the Fight phase: pick one of your <DYNASTY> LYCHGUARD units. Until the phase ends, while it is within 3" of one of your <DYNASTY> NOBLE models, each of its models gets 1 extra attack.

0a69c072be49.name: Masters of the Martial
0a69c072be49.plain: Each time a unit with this code is picked to shoot or fight, one of the hit rolls for those attacks can be re-rolled.

0b61188c9251.name: Cryptogeometric Adjuster
0b61188c9251.plain: At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, you can pick one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer that the bearer can see. Until the phase ends, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made by a model in that unit.

0b9fba20f65b.name: Living Lightning
0b9fba20f65b.plain: When the Fight phase starts, roll a D6 for each enemy unit that is within 6" of this model; each unit you roll a 4+ for takes 1 mortal wound.

0c74b9dc1e00.name: Command Protocols
0c74b9dc1e00.plain: A summary of the Command Protocols appears at the bottom of the list output.

0ca828497593.name: Voidreaper
0ca828497593.plain: When an attack is made with this weapon, no rules that ignore wounds can be used. This Relic takes the place of a warscythe or voidscythe.

0ccb4a882a9c.name: Aggressively Territorial
0ccb4a882a9c.plain: Units with this code get the Objective Secured ability. If one of their models already has that ability, it counts as one extra model when working out who controls an objective marker. While a unit with this code is wholly within its controller's deployment zone, attacks with an Armour Penetration characteristic of -1 that are allocated to its models count as having an Armour Penetration characteristic of 0 instead. If all the units in your army (not counting DYNASTIC AGENT and C'TAN SHARD units) have this code, you can pick both directives of the Protocol of the Eternal Guardian, not just one, whenever it becomes active for your army.

0d9eb85fac20.name: Resurrection Protocols
0d9eb85fac20.plain: In any phase, when one of your NECRONS INFANTRY NOBLE or NECRONS INFANTRY CRYPTEK models is destroyed: instead of using any rules that trigger when it is destroyed (such as Surrogate Hosts abilities), you can choose to roll a D6 at the end of the phase. On a 4+, put that model back on the battlefield as close as possible to the spot where it was destroyed and more than 1" away from all enemy models, with D3 wounds left. You can't use this Stratagem to bring back the same model more than once per battle.

0f904a29e575.name: Protectors (Aura)
0f904a29e575.plain: Aura: a CRYPTEK unit of yours that is within 3" of this unit can benefit from the Look Out, Sir rule, even if this unit has fewer than 3 models.

10dd0f32b8cf.name: Teleportation matrix
10dd0f32b8cf.plain: This model gets the Dimensional Translocation ability.

114752eab02f.name: Lord of the Storm
114752eab02f.plain: In your Shooting phase, once per battle, this model can call the storm. To do so, choose an enemy model that it can see within 48" (a CHARACTER model with a Wounds characteristic of 9 or less is only a valid choice if it is the closest enemy model to Imotekh). For every other enemy unit within 6" of the chosen model, roll a D6: on a 4+ that unit takes D3 mortal wounds. After that, roll a single D6: on a 4+ the chosen model takes 3 mortal wounds.

1281a00774f6.name: Gauntlet of the Conflagrator
1281a00774f6.plain: Attacks with this weapon hit the target automatically. Don't make a wound roll: instead, roll one D6 for each model in the target unit, and that unit suffers 1 mortal wound for every 6 rolled; then the attack sequence ends.

12b4b5ada8c5.name: Voltaic Staff (Melee)
12b4b5ada8c5.plain: This Relic takes the place of a staff of light.

135f6eed05b7.name: Cult of Annihilation
135f6eed05b7.plain: This unit never gets a Dynastic Code. Whenever a model with this ability attacks a unit that was below its Starting Strength when this model was picked to shoot or fight, add 1 to that attack's hit roll. If the target unit was below Half-strength at that time, also add 1 to the attack's wound roll.

14586c074c99.name: My Will Be Done
14586c074c99.plain: In your Command phase, this unit can choose one of your <DYNASTY> CORE units that is within 9" of it. Add 1 to the hit roll of each attack made by a model in the chosen unit until your next Command phase begins. No unit can be chosen for this ability more than once per phase.

160caea635c6.name: Chronometron
160caea635c6.plain: In your Command phase, you can choose one of your <DYNASTY> units that is within 9" of this model. Until your next Command phase begins, the chosen unit's models have a 5+ invulnerable save and you can re-roll its charge rolls.

16abec903b82.name: Relentless March (Aura)
16abec903b82.plain: Aura: while one of your <DYNASTY> CORE units is within 6" of this model, whenever that unit is picked to make a Normal Move or Advance, its models' Move characteristic goes up by 1" until the phase ends.

172ab2afe557.name: The Stars Are Right
172ab2afe557.plain: If this model is on the battlefield in your Command phase, roll a D6. When the result is lower than the current battle round number, switch this model to its Orikan Empowered profile for the rest of the battle (any wounds it has already lost stay lost).

175c7df67a67.name: Ever-Present Protector
175c7df67a67.plain: If NEMESOR ZAHNDREKH is in a Detachment, VARGARD OBYRON can also be in that Detachment without using up a Battlefield Role slot.

18f4021d6b11.name: The Royal Court
18f4021d6b11.plain: When you muster your army, your WARLORD must be chosen in this order of priority: THE SILENT KING model if your army has one; if not, a PHAERON model; if not, an OVERLORD model; if not, a LORD model. If your army has none of these models, pick your WARLORD in the normal way.

1964d13cf27c.name: Cosmic Tyrant
1964d13cf27c.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, if this model didn't Advance or Fall Back that phase, it can use 1 extra C'tan Power it knows. It can't use the same C'tan Power more than once per turn.

1a3a5aa3ede6.name: Annihilation Protocols - Protocol of Perfect Destruction
1a3a5aa3ede6.plain:
Directive 1: this unit adds 1 to its charge rolls.
Directive 2: models in this unit can move up to an extra 3" whenever they pile in or consolidate.

1af90a895fe1.name: Nano-Scarab Reanimation Beam (Aura)
1af90a895fe1.plain: Aura: in your Command phase, you can pick one of your <DYNASTY> units within 6" of this model that it can see. Until the start of your next Command phase, while that unit stays within 6" of this model and visible to it, it is being healed by this model's reanimation beam. A unit being healed by a reanimation beam adds 1 to its Reanimation Protocol rolls. A unit can never be healed by more than one reanimation beam at the same time.

1b98a1c4aa99.name: Powers of the C'tan (Instructions)
1b98a1c4aa99.plain:
Before the battle, work out the Powers of the C'tan for your C'TAN SHARD units using the table below. Either roll a D6 for each power to generate it at random (re-roll any duplicates), or choose the powers each unit knows. If you choose, every power must have been chosen at least once across your army before any power can be picked again, and a single unit can't know one power twice. Record the Powers of the C'tan each unit knows on your army roster.

On the table, 1 is Antimatter Meteor, 2 is Time's Arrow, 3 is Sky of Falling Stars, 4 is Cosmic Fire, 5 is Seismic Assault and 6 is Transdimensional Thunderbolt.

1c911a505a5c.name: Reclaim a Lost Empire
1c911a505a5c.plain: In your Shooting phase: pick one of your NIHILAKH INFANTRY units that is in the middle of performing an action. It can shoot this phase and the action does not fail.

1e068ccc1262.name: Veil of Darkness
1e068ccc1262.plain: Once per battle, in your Movement phase, you can set up the bearer's unit and up to one of your <DYNASTY> CORE units within 3" of the bearer somewhere else. Remove them from the battlefield, then set them up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models. If 2 units are set up again this way, they must both end up wholly within 6" of each other.

204acb6479dc.name: Rarefied Nobility
204acb6479dc.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the NECRONS keyword: pick one NECRONS CHARACTER model in your army (not a C'TAN SHARD model) and give it one Warlord Trait it is allowed to have. That model counts as your WARLORD only for that Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if generating them at random), and this Stratagem can't give a model a second Warlord Trait. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

2067bc06a367.name: Blood-Fuelled Fury
2067bc06a367.plain: When this WARLORD attacks in melee, each unmodified wound roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of the attack's normal damage.

209301605138.name: Death Descending
209301605138.plain: During deployment, you can place this model in the upper atmosphere rather than on the battlefield. If you do, in the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases you can set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy models.

20a22fc4a6ff.name: Extermination Protocols
20a22fc4a6ff.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your LOKHUST DESTROYERS or LOKHUST HEAVY DESTROYERS units is picked to shoot: until the phase ends, you can re-roll the wound roll for every attack made by a model in that unit.

20d93044d877.name: Wrecked
20d93044d877.plain: Whenever a model in this unit is destroyed, roll a D6 before you remove it. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 9" takes D6 mortal wounds. On any other roll, it becomes a wreck: it counts as destroyed for all rules, but you leave it on the battlefield, and for the rest of the battle it is an Obstacle terrain feature with the Difficult Ground, Exposed Position and Unstable Position terrain traits.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Rules"

212697c763c7.name: Immortal Pride (Aura)
212697c763c7.plain: Aura: while one of your <DYNASTY> CORE units is within 6" of this model, you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Combat Attrition tests.

22d2f390af46.name: Orb of Eternity
22d2f390af46.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, you can use this Relic to enact the reanimation protocols of one of your <DYNASTY> units within 6" of the bearer. That unit must be below its Starting Strength and must not have had its reanimation protocols enacted this phase. Every destroyed model in it begins to reassemble, and you add 1 to each Reanimation Protocol roll made for those protocols. This Relic takes the place of a resurrection orb.

22fd57c533af.name: Ancient Collector
22fd57c533af.plain: If this model is in your army, the first time you use the Dynastic Heirlooms Stratagem it costs 1 Command point less. If this model is in your Crusade force, the Relic Requisition costs 0 Requisition Points.

231e5ea1dc17.name: Unyielding
231e5ea1dc17.plain: Models with this code get a 6+ invulnerable save.

23b6ee852be7.name: Tesseract Singularity Chamber (Particle Hurricane)
23b6ee852be7.plain: Every attack made with this weapon hits the target automatically, and a wound roll of 2+ always succeeds. Against a VEHICLE target, a wound roll of 6 always succeeds instead.

23d058328d43.name: Atavistic Instigation
23d058328d43.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your DOOM SCYTHE models is picked to shoot: after choosing the target for its heavy death ray, pick one enemy unit within 3" of that target (it can be the target itself). That enemy unit chooses whether to brace or duck for cover. If it braces and is not a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, it takes D3 mortal wounds. If it ducks for cover, then until the end of the turn its models subtract 1 from their Attacks characteristic, and it can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend.

2402a6fabfdb.name: Their Number Is Legion
2402a6fabfdb.plain: Each 1 rolled on this unit's Reanimation Protocol rolls must be re-rolled.

24b16c816af2.name: Evasion Protocol
24b16c816af2.plain: While this model is within 3" of one of your <DYNASTY> DESTROYER CULT units, enemy models can't target it with ranged weapons unless it is the closest eligible target. Also, this unit can't perform actions.

24c0fa49f3e4.name: Grand Illusion
24c0fa49f3e4.plain: At the start of the first battle round, you can pick up to three of your NECRONS units. Take them off the battlefield and set them up again anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. Then, if the mission uses Strategic Reserves, you can put any of these units into Strategic Reserves at no extra CP cost, no matter how many units are already there. If both players have abilities that redeploy units, roll off, and the winner decides who redeploys first.

2771a7370c9d.name: Fractured Personality
2771a7370c9d.plain:
Before the battle, pick 1 of the 6 abilities below; this model keeps it all battle. Or roll 2 D6 instead and give it both abilities you rolled (on a double, reroll both dice until they show different numbers).

1 Cosmic Tyrant: if this model neither Advanced nor Fell Back in your Movement phase, then at the end of that phase it may use 1 more C'tan Power from those it knows. No single C'tan Power can be used by it twice in one turn.
2 Immune to Natural Law: when attacks target this model, any wound roll that is an unmodified 1-3 fails, no matter what abilities the weapon or its wielder have.
3 Sentient Necrodermis: its Save becomes 3+.
4 Transdimensional Displacement: it gains Dimensional Translocation.
5 Untamed Power: its Attacks become 6 and its Strength 7.
6 Writhing Worldscape: as your Movement phase begins, roll a D6 for every enemy unit in Engagement Range of this model; on 4+, that unit takes 1 mortal wound. Also, after a unit declares a charge against this model, subtract 2 from its charge rolls for the rest of the phase.

27d98ac08c75.name: Tomb Guardians
27d98ac08c75.plain:
This unit:
- never gains a Dynastic Code.
- has 1 added to its models' Attacks characteristic.
- lets you re-roll its Reanimation Protocol rolls of 1.

288140f8b453.name: Murderous Demise
288140f8b453.plain: In the Fight phase, when a CHARACTER model from your army is destroyed before it has been picked to fight this phase: use this instead of any other abilities that trigger on its death. Leave the model in play. Once the attacking model's unit has finished its attacks, the destroyed model can either shoot as though it were your Shooting phase, or be picked to fight. Remove it after its attacks are resolved.

288f50116b1b.name: The Swarm Descends
288f50116b1b.plain: Before the battle: pick one of your CANOPTEK SCARAB SWARM units. It gains the Dimensional Translocation ability.

28af2a8c8efd.name: Dimensional Translocation
28af2a8c8efd.plain: During deployment, you can place this unit in a hyperspace dimension rather than on the battlefield. If you do, in the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases you can set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy models.

2a7b5d572a83.name: Pitiless Hunters
2a7b5d572a83.plain: Models with this code make double the number of attacks with Rapid Fire weapons when their target is within half the weapon's range. INFANTRY models with this code also do so if their unit Remained Stationary in your previous Movement phase. This replaces the normal Rapid Fire rules.

2aaf6c682854.name: Disintegration Capacitors
2aaf6c682854.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your NECRONS units is picked to shoot: until the phase ends, whenever a model in it attacks with a gauss weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically.

2b82100a4f02.name: Death Sphere Bombardment
2b82100a4f02.plain: Once per battle, when this model finishes a Normal Move or Advance in your Movement phase and is still on the battlefield, you can choose one enemy unit it passed over during that move. Then roll 3D6 for every VEHICLE or MONSTER model in the chosen unit, plus one D6 for every other model in it (to a maximum of twelve D6). The unit takes 1 mortal wound for each 3+ rolled.

waive.2023: date of the rules update note (January 2023 dataslate), not a game value

2bd895385d13.name: Command Protocols
2bd895385d13.plain:
This unit can benefit from this ability, and the rules below apply, if every unit in your army (not counting DYNASTIC AGENT, C'TAN SHARD and UNALIGNED units) comes from the same dynasty and your WARLORD is a NECRONS CHARACTER model.

Once both sides have deployed, and before you determine who takes the first turn, you must secretly assign a different command protocol to each of the first five battle rounds and write this on your army roster.

At the start of every battle round, if at least one NECRONS CHARACTER unit from your army is on the battlefield, the command protocol assigned to that round becomes active for your army until that round ends. Every command protocol has two directives. When one becomes active, show it to your opponent and choose one of its directives. For as long as that protocol stays active, each unit eligible for this ability that is on the battlefield gets the benefit of the chosen directive.

Also, if all your army's units are from the same dynasty (not counting DYNASTIC AGENT, C'TAN SHARD and UNALIGNED units), pick one command protocol that wasn't assigned to any battle round (normally there is only one left). It is active in every battle round on top of that round's assigned protocol; at the start of each battle round, choose which of its directives your units benefit from. If this extra protocol is the one named in your dynasty's code, then both of its directives apply to every unit with this ability in your army in every battle round, on top of the protocol assigned to that round.

2f6fe3b865b4.name: Cosmic Insanity
2f6fe3b865b4.plain: Pick one enemy unit within 12" of this C'TAN SHARD that it can see; it suffers 1 mortal wound for each point by which your total beats your opponent's. To get the totals, you roll one D6 and add this C'TAN SHARD's Leadership characteristic, then your opponent rolls one D6 and adds that unit's Leadership characteristic.

2ffb2f94a978.name: Nightcull Scythe
2ffb2f94a978.plain: Excess damage from this weapon's attacks isn't lost: keep allocating it to other models in the target unit until none is left or the unit is destroyed. This Relic takes the place of a Hyperphase Harvester.

30206059fae5.name: Guardian Protocols (Aura)
30206059fae5.plain: Aura: any of your <DYNASTY> INFANTRY NOBLE or DYNASTIC AGENT INFANTRY NOBLE units within 3" of this unit can benefit from the Look Out, Sir rule, even if this unit has fewer than 3 models.

30316f843d57.name: Sentinel Construct
30316f843d57.plain: Whenever an enemy unit declares a charge against one of your <DYNASTY> or DYNASTIC AGENT units within 6" of this model, this model can fire Overwatch at the charging unit as though it were also a target of the charge, as long as it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy models. This is on top of any other units firing Overwatch. Whenever this model fires Overwatch, it attacks with the high power profile of its doomsday blaster.

30aeeb6ab52e.name: Healthy Paranoia
30aeeb6ab52e.plain: Models with this code add 3" to the Range characteristic of their ranged weapons, except Pistols.

3126964d5af4.name: Seismic Assault
3126964d5af4.plain: Pick one enemy unit within 18" of this C'TAN SHARD that it can see and roll one D6 per model in it: each 6+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the unit (10 at most). If this C'TAN SHARD is a TESSERACT VAULT, add 1 to each of those rolls.

3221390a4a15.name: The Triarch's Will
3221390a4a15.plain: If your WARLORD has this Warlord Trait, you can pick 4 command protocols instead of 5 when you assign them for the battle. You can then assign one of those protocols to 2 battle rounds instead of one.

33024ceb3ec4.name: Gaze of Death
33024ceb3ec4.plain: Pick one enemy unit within 9" of this C'TAN SHARD that it can see and roll 3 D6s: that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds for each 4+.

3396719c0df2.name: Phaeron of the Stars (Aura)
3396719c0df2.plain: Aura: while one of your NECRONS CORE or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS units is within 6" of Szarekh, you can re-roll the hit roll for each ranged attack made by a model in that unit.

34f17a09c074.name: Arkana: Autodivinator
34f17a09c074.plain: If the bearer is on the battlefield when your Command phase starts, roll a D6; you gain 1 Command point on a 5+.

3558eb540bd8.name: Efficient Disintegration
3558eb540bd8.plain: In any phase, when one of your LOKHUST DESTROYERS or LOKHUST HEAVY DESTROYERS units is picked to shoot: until the phase ends, whenever a model in it attacks with a gauss cannon or gauss destructor, add 1 to that attack's damage roll.

35c0cb7299db.name: Predictive Strategist
35c0cb7299db.plain: Once per battle, when you use a Stratagem while your army is Battle-forged and this model is on the battlefield, this model can use its Predictive Strategy to make that Stratagem cost 1CP less (to a minimum of 0CP). This discount only applies to that single use; using the Stratagem again later costs the usual amount of CP.

35c1ed76a29d.name: Annihilation Protocols - Protocol of the Dread Strike
35c1ed76a29d.plain:
Directive 1: melee attacks by models in this unit automatically wound the target on an unmodified hit roll of 6.
Directive 2: add 1 to the wound roll of a ranged attack by a model in this unit when that attack has an unmodified hit roll of 6.

3678759ac787.name: Inspiring Leader (Aura)
3678759ac787.plain: Aura: your units add 1 to their Leadership characteristic while they are within 6" of this WARLORD.

36a610f7318f.name: Mask of Obliteration (Details)
36a610f7318f.plain: When the bearer is picked to shoot, it can merge the shots of its enmitic disintegrator pistols into one obliteration beam rather than shooting normally. If it does, it uses the following profile instead of attacking with each of those pistols.

3a54c9b9fce7.name: Adaptive Strategy
3a54c9b9fce7.plain: In your Command phase, you can choose one of your <DYNASTY> CORE units that is within 9" of this model. For the rest of the turn, that unit can still shoot and declare a charge in a turn when it Fell Back.

3b776d1fe5d3.name: Sky of Falling Stars
3b776d1fe5d3.plain: Up to 3 enemy units within 24" of this C'TAN SHARD can each suffer D3 mortal wounds. Pick them and roll one D6 for each: on a 1-5, if the result is lower than the number of models in that unit, it suffers D3 mortal wounds, or 3 mortal wounds instead of D3 if this C'TAN SHARD is a TESSERACT VAULT.

3c09cc9017d9.name: Dimensional Sanctum
3c09cc9017d9.plain: The bearer gets the Dimensional Translocation ability.

3c6a5a857901.name: Recall Protocol
3c6a5a857901.plain: In the Unit Coherency Checks step of the Morale phase, this model is destroyed if it is not within 6" of any of your <DYNASTY> DESTROYER CULT units.

3c87aad9da14.name: Tachyon Arrow
3c87aad9da14.plain: The bearer can fire this weapon only once per battle.

3d7e9b364d3d.name: Enslaved Star God
3d7e9b364d3d.plain: This model can never be given a Relic or a Warlord Trait. Also, when enemy models pick this model as the target of a ranged attack, they can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule.

3d9fc81edda3.name: Defence Field (Aura)
3d9fc81edda3.plain: Aura: models in any of your <DYNASTY> units have a 5+ invulnerable save while their unit is within 6" of this unit's Power Crucible model.

403c47209545.name: The Silent King
403c47209545.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, Szarekh has to be its WARLORD. If Szarekh is your WARLORD, you get 3 extra Command points.

425be7590e12.name: Gauss Annihilator (Focused Beam)
425be7590e12.plain: Blast. Add 2 to the hit roll of each attack this weapon makes against an AIRCRAFT unit.

42a8e6e734e0.name: Solar Staff (Ranged)
42a8e6e734e0.plain: If an attack with this weapon hits an INFANTRY unit, that unit is blinded until the end of the turn. A blinded unit can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend. This Relic takes the place of a staff of light.

4307a65911ef.name: Arkana: Obedience Nanoscarabs
4307a65911ef.plain: PSYCHOMANCER model only: whenever you use the bearer's Harbinger of Despair ability, you can pick two of its effects rather than just one.

43eee02d2f7c.name: Honourable Combatant
43eee02d2f7c.plain: In the Fight phase, each time this WARLORD is picked to fight, it can engage in honourable combat: pick one enemy CHARACTER unit. Until the end of the phase, this WARLORD gets 2 extra attacks, but every attack it makes must target that enemy CHARACTER unit.

440576934b73.name: Resurrection Amplifier (Aura)
440576934b73.plain: Aura: add 1 to the Reanimation Protocol rolls of any of your <DYNASTY> CORE units while they are within 6" of this unit's Power Crucible model.

4414875eb6d7.name: Powers of the C'tan (Deceiver)
4414875eb6d7.plain: Besides the Cosmic Insanity C'tan Power, this model knows one more power chosen from the Powers of the C'tan. If it neither Advanced nor Fell Back during your Movement phase, it can use two different C'tan Powers it knows at the end of that phase; it can't use any one C'tan Power more than once per turn.

4499c4448b6c.name: Living Metal
4499c4448b6c.plain: At the start of your Command phase, every model in this unit gets back 1 lost wound.

44f72e453645.name: Repair Barge
44f72e453645.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your <DYNASTY> NECRON WARRIORS units within 6" of this model. If you do, up to D3 of that unit's destroyed models Reanimate. A unit can't be picked for this ability more than once per phase.

44fe442c3f98.name: Nanoscarab Casket
44fe442c3f98.plain: Whenever the bearer uses its Living Metal ability, it gets back 1 extra lost wound.

45a7a11d53fa.name: Voltaic Staff (Shooting)
45a7a11d53fa.plain: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 with this weapon scores 2 extra hits. This Relic takes the place of a staff of light.

462f970e1b17.name: Exalted Cryptek
462f970e1b17.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army: pick one CRYPTEK model from your army. It can have two items of Cryptek Arkana rather than one. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

46f1426f74ef.name: The Deathless Arise
46f1426f74ef.plain: In your Command phase: pick one of your TECHNOMANCER models. Until the phase ends, it can use its Rites of Reanimation ability one extra time.

47a66cfde595.name: Aeonstave (Melee)
47a66cfde595.plain: Your opponent can't use invulnerable saves against attacks made with this weapon.

4868b3c0e723.name: Fail-Safe Overcharger
4868b3c0e723.plain: In your Command phase, you can choose one of your CANOPTEK units that is within 9" of the bearer. Until your next Command phase begins, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's models, or add D3 instead if it is a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit.

487261160aa6.name: Hypermaterial Ablator
487261160aa6.plain: In your Command phase, you can choose one of your <DYNASTY> CORE or <DYNASTY> CANOPTEK units that is within 9" of the bearer. Until your next Command phase begins, that unit counts as having the benefits of light cover against any ranged attack whose attacker is more than 12" away.

4a5869f4eb02.name: Bound Creation
4a5869f4eb02.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, each CRYPTEK unit in a Detachment lets you include one CRYPTOTHRALLS unit in that Detachment without using up a Battlefield Role slot.

4db4c64c227e.name: Voltaic Storm
4db4c64c227e.plain: Pick one enemy unit within 18" of this C'TAN SHARD that it can see and roll one D6: on a 2+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds (D6 if it is a VEHICLE). An enemy CHARACTER unit whose Wounds characteristic is 9 or less can't be picked while it is within 3" of any other enemy unit, unless it is the closest visible enemy unit. Also on a 2+, if the target is a VEHICLE with characteristics that change as it loses wounds, then until the start of your next turn it counts its remaining wounds as half their number when working out which characteristics it uses.

4dd69e1ed379.name: Merciless Tyrant
4dd69e1ed379.plain: This WARLORD's Strength and Attacks characteristics are each increased by 1.

4f05e5954866.name: Sempiternal Weave
4f05e5954866.plain: The bearer's Toughness and Wounds characteristics are each increased by 1.

5136b1380842.name: Secondary Objective - Purge the Vermin
5136b1380842.plain: Battlefield Supremacy: at the end of your turn, score 2 victory points per table quarter with no enemy units (except AIRCRAFT units) wholly within it. You can't score this objective in the first battle round.

5218e93a1768.name: Resurrection Orb
5218e93a1768.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, the bearer can activate its resurrection orb. When it does, choose one of your <DYNASTY> units within 6" of the bearer that is below Starting Strength and whose reanimation protocols haven't been enacted yet this phase. Enact that unit's reanimation protocols: all of its destroyed models start to reassemble.

53a78f3ff72b.name: Metalodermal Tesla Weave
53a78f3ff72b.plain: At the end of the Charges step in your opponent's Charge phase, you may choose an enemy unit that ended a charge move this phase within 6" of the bearer. Roll a D6, and on a 2+ it takes D3 mortal wounds.

547322b0f4d7.name: Canoptek Tail Blades
547322b0f4d7.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it makes D6 extra attacks with this weapon.

55f9561416c9.name: Prismatic Obfuscatron
55f9561416c9.plain: Enemy models can't target the bearer with ranged attacks unless it is the closest eligible target.

560ed895956c.name: Phylactery
560ed895956c.plain: Whenever this model uses its Living Metal ability, it gets back up to D3 lost wounds rather than 1.

56115f438623.name: Reconstitution Protocols
56115f438623.plain: In your Command phase: pick one of your GHOST ARK units. Until the phase ends, whenever it uses its Repair Barge ability, you can put up to D6 destroyed models back on the battlefield rather than D3.

5612117b84cc.name: Overkill Protocols
5612117b84cc.plain: In your Command phase: pick one of your CANOPTEK WRAITHS units. Until the start of your next Command phase, whenever a model in it attacks with vicious claws, that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic improves by 1; and whenever a model in it attacks with whip coils, you make one extra hit roll.

5685d1853a22.name: Translocation Beams
5685d1853a22.plain: Models with this code get a 6+ invulnerable save. When a unit with this code Advances, it can translocate instead of making an Advance roll: until the end of the phase, add 6" to its models' Move characteristic, but its models can't shoot until the end of the turn. When a unit with this code Falls Back or translocates, its models can move through models and terrain as though they were not there until the phase ends. If all the units in your army (not counting DYNASTIC AGENT and C'TAN SHARD units) have this code, you can pick both directives of the Protocol of the Sudden Storm, not just one, whenever it becomes active for your army.

57f876ee08ac.name: Ziggurat Dock
57f876ee08ac.plain: During deployment, you can put one of your <DYNASTY> MONOLITH or <DYNASTY> SENTRY PYLON models on top of the Tomb Ziggurat model in this unit. If so, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that model's weapons until that Monolith or Sentry Pylon unit moves.

594727913f81.name: Disruption Fields
594727913f81.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your NECRONS CORE units is picked to fight: models in that unit add 1 to their Strength characteristic until the phase ends.

59803865b7e3.name: Curse of the Phaeron
59803865b7e3.plain: In any phase, when one of your NECRONS VEHICLE models is destroyed: it explodes automatically, so don't roll to see whether it does. This Stratagem costs 3CP if that model has the TITANIC keyword, or 1 CP if it does not.

5b09597fe8d4.name: Phase Shift Generator
5b09597fe8d4.plain: While they are within 6" of this model, your NECRONS models get a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

5b77d2315c86.name: Spirit of Madness
5b77d2315c86.plain: Whenever this model makes a melee attack against a unit whose Leadership characteristic is lower than this model's, you can re-roll the hit roll.

5d474ca02c89.name: Shadows of Drazak
5d474ca02c89.plain: In any phase, when one of your FLAYED ONES units is picked as the target of an attack: until the phase ends, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made against that unit.

5f4f8dc33efc.name: Quantum Deflection
5f4f8dc33efc.plain: In any phase, when one of your NECRONS QUANTUM SHIELDING units is picked as the target of an attack: its models have a 4+ invulnerable save until the phase ends.

606a87ec3b57.name: Systematic Vigour
606a87ec3b57.plain: While this unit is within 6" of any of your CRYPTEK units, its models have Weapon Skill 3+, Ballistic Skill 3+ and an Attacks characteristic of 6.

60ed2b048227.name: Contemptuous of the Codes
60ed2b048227.plain: You can add 1 to the hit roll of any attack a model with this code makes against a CHARACTER unit.

617281065d6c.name: Transdimensional Displacement
617281065d6c.plain: This model also gets the Dimensional Translocation ability.

633025defe9f.name: Command Protocols - Protocol of the Sudden Storm
633025defe9f.plain:
Directive 1: models in this unit add 1" to their Move characteristic.
Directive 2: this unit can make ranged attacks while performing an action without the action failing.

6526103295c9.name: Fabricator Claw Array
6526103295c9.plain: When your Movement phase ends, the bearer can repair one of your <DYNASTY> VEHICLE models within 3" of it, which gets back up to D3 lost wounds. No model can be repaired more than once per turn.

658750a3ef54.name: Time's Arrow
658750a3ef54.plain: Pick one enemy unit within 18" of this C'TAN SHARD that it can see and roll one D6 (add 1 if this C'TAN SHARD is a TESSERACT VAULT). If the result is equal to or higher than the Wounds characteristic of any models in that unit, your opponent picks one of those models and it is destroyed.

659faabfab93.name: Immune to Natural Law
659faabfab93.plain: Attacks against this model always fail to wound on an unmodified wound roll of 1-3, whatever abilities the attacker's weapon has.

66699eb017df.name: Aetheric Interception
66699eb017df.plain: During the Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase, once an enemy unit has been placed on the battlefield: choose one of your HYPERSPACE HUNTER units that is currently in Strategic Reserves, in a hyperspace dimension, or on the battlefield. If the chosen unit is in a hyperspace dimension or Strategic Reserves, place it anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from all enemy models and within 18" of that enemy unit. Then, at the end of the phase, the HYPERSPACE HUNTER unit can shoot as though it were your Shooting phase; until the phase ends, the only unit it can target is the enemy unit that was just set up (and only when that unit is an eligible target).

66f727e4b3f4.name: Fractured Personality (Instructions)
66f727e4b3f4.plain: Before the battle, choose one ability from the table for this model to keep for the whole battle. Or, instead, roll two D6 and look up both results to give this model two random abilities (if both dice show the same number, roll both again until they differ). On the table, 1 is Cosmic Tyrant, 2 is Immune to Natural Law, 3 is Sentient Necrodermis, 4 is Transdimensional Displacement, 5 is Untamed Power and 6 is Writhing Worldscape.

67a0c23b0390.name: Transdimensional Thunderbolt
67a0c23b0390.plain: Pick one enemy unit within 24" of this C'TAN SHARD that it can see and roll one D6: on a 2+, the target suffers D3 mortal wounds. An enemy CHARACTER unit whose Wounds characteristic is 9 or less can't be picked while it is within 3" of any other enemy unit, unless it is the closest visible enemy unit. Next, roll one D6 for every other enemy unit within 3" of the target (6" instead if this C'TAN SHARD is a TESSERACT VAULT); each one you roll a 4+ for suffers 1 mortal wound.

69c41b52d3f6.name: Harbinger of Despair
69c41b52d3f6.plain: In your Morale phase, you can pick an enemy unit within 12" of this model, then roll 3D6. If the result beats that unit's Leadership characteristic, choose one of the results opposite; it applies until the start of your next Morale phase. A unit can't be picked for this ability more than once per phase.

6ab64d78a5cb.name: Atomic Energy Manipulator
6ab64d78a5cb.plain: If this model destroys at least one enemy model in the Fight phase, it can use its Mechanical Augmentation ability at the end of that phase, as though it were the end of your Movement phase.

6aff7c2c9aff.name: Arkana: Neutron Shroud
6aff7c2c9aff.plain: The bearer's Save characteristic is 2+. Once per battle, the bearer can activate the shroud before you make a saving throw for it; if it does, it has a 3+ invulnerable save until the phase ends.

6b1698f18f57.name: Conduit of Stars
6b1698f18f57.plain: This Relic takes the place of a relic gauss blaster.

6c0cbab1d07b.name: Transient Madness
6c0cbab1d07b.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your SAUTEKH CORE units that is within 9" of this model, then roll 3D6. If the result is lower than this model's Leadership characteristic, you can choose one of the results below to apply to that unit; if not, roll a D3 to find out which result below applies to it.

6dc8cbf4db48.name: Malevolent Arcing
6dc8cbf4db48.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your NECRONS models targets an enemy unit with a tesla weapon: once that weapon's attacks are made, roll a D6 for every other unit within 6" of that enemy unit. Each unit you roll a 4+ for takes 1 mortal wound.

6eac84e9f90d.name: Gloom Prism
6eac84e9f90d.plain: During your opponent's Psychic phase, the bearer's unit can try to deny a single psychic power, as though it were a PSYKER.

70fa19605e31.name: Slinking Strike
70fa19605e31.plain: This unit can shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

71eb3d492a45.name: My Will Be Done (Necrons)
71eb3d492a45.plain: In your Command phase, this unit can choose one of your NECRONS CORE units that is within 9" of it. Add 1 to the hit roll of each attack made by a model in the chosen unit until your next Command phase begins. No unit can be chosen for this ability more than once per phase.

72d2fcfc006c.name: Powers of the C'tan (Transcendent)
72d2fcfc006c.plain: From the Powers of the C'tan, this model knows two C'tan Powers. If it neither Advanced nor Fell Back during your Movement phase, it can use one C'tan Power it knows at the end of that phase. It may never use any one C'tan Power twice in a turn.

72e56d32b38a.name: Eternal Madness
72e56d32b38a.plain: You can re-roll the wound roll for each melee attack this WARLORD makes.

7495b887d1b6.name: Dynastic Heirlooms
7495b887d1b6.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the NECRONS keyword: pick one NECRONS CHARACTER model in your army (not a C'TAN SHARD model) and give it one Relic it is allowed to have. Every Relic in your army must be different, and this Stratagem can't give a model a second Relic. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

74b9b51fa54f.name: Secondary Objective - Ancient Machineries
74b9b51fa54f.plain:
Shadow Operations secondary objective: score 3 victory points each time one of your units completes the Awaken Ancient Machinery action.

After both sides have deployed, the players take turns, starting with your opponent, picking objective markers outside every player's deployment zone as Ancient Machinery objective markers until 3 are picked (if only 1 or 2 such markers exist, just those are Ancient Machinery objective markers).

Awaken Ancient Machinery (Action): one or more of your NECRONS CORE or NECRONS CANOPTEK units can start this action at the end of your Movement phase. Each unit that starts it must be in range of a different Ancient Machinery objective marker, and no unit can start it while any enemy unit (other than AIRCRAFT) is in range of that same marker. It is completed at the end of your next Command phase, as long as the unit is still in range of its Ancient Machinery objective marker.

75cef71e4601.name: Rites of Reanimation (Necrons)
75cef71e4601.plain: In your Command phase, you can choose one of your NECRONS CORE units that is within 6" of this model. One of that unit's destroyed models is Reanimated, or D3 of them if it is a NECRON WARRIORS unit. No unit can be chosen for this ability more than once per phase.

76236aa11426.name: Secondary Objective - Code of Combat
76236aa11426.plain: No Mercy, No Respite secondary objective: at the end of the battle, score 3 victory points for every enemy unit destroyed by one of your NECRONS NOBLE units.

768b03fa2c1a.name: Hyperdense Particle Beams
768b03fa2c1a.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your CULT OF THE CRYPTEK units is picked to shoot: until the phase ends, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 2 for every attack a model in it makes with a particle beamer or particle caster.

77a1d38e55b5.name: Phylacterine Hive
77a1d38e55b5.plain: Once per battle, the bearer's Rites of Reanimation ability can affect a different kind of unit. When using it, you may have it affect one of your <DYNASTY> CANOPTEK, <DYNASTY> DESTROYER CULT or TRIARCH PRAETORIAN units rather than one of your <DYNASTY> CORE units.

787b2db408ae.name: Revenge of the Doomstalker
787b2db408ae.plain: In any phase, when an enemy unit destroys one of your <DYNASTY> CHARACTER units: pick one of your <DYNASTY> CANOPTEK DOOMSTALKER models. When the phase ends, that CANOPTEK DOOMSTALKER model can shoot as though it were your Shooting phase, but only at that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for the attack). For the rest of the battle, add 1 to the hit roll whenever that CANOPTEK DOOMSTALKER model attacks that enemy unit.

7892d2280142.name: Tomb Citadel
7892d2280142.plain: Once this unit has been set up: its Tomb Ziggurat counts as a terrain feature with the Scaleable, Defensible, Light Cover and Obscuring traits; its Power Crucible counts as a terrain feature with the Unstable Position, Dense Cover and Obscuring traits; and its Gun Emplacement Mounts count as terrain features with the Unstable Position, Dense Cover and Obscuring traits.

78deedc0e123.name: Supersonic
78deedc0e123.plain: Whenever this model makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, first turn it on the spot by up to 90 degrees (this doesn't count toward the distance it moves), then move it straight forwards. After that first pivot, it can't pivot again.

7917829d5c10.name: Annihilation Protocols - Protocol of the Killing Surge
7917829d5c10.plain:
Directive 1: models in this unit add 2" to their Move characteristic.
Directive 2: this unit can charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

7a01fbdf2cee.name: The Vargard's Duty (Aura)
7a01fbdf2cee.plain: Aura: enemy models can't target a NEMESOR ZAHNDREKH unit of yours with ranged attacks while it is within 3" of this model.

7e5228d250fa.name: Annihilation Protocols - Protocol of the Immortal Warrior
7e5228d250fa.plain:
Directive 1: add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of this unit's models.
Directive 2: improve the Save characteristic of this unit's models by 1, to no better than 2+. This doesn't affect invulnerable saves.

7f4a86db2a5b.name: Reanimation Protocols

7fab75a7271e.name: The Ancients Stir
7fab75a7271e.plain: CANOPTEK models with this code add 1" to their Move characteristic. Whenever a CANOPTEK unit with this code piles in or consolidates, each of its models can move up to 4", as long as every model that moves ends closer to the closest enemy model.

80111b87ad7e.name: Targeting Relay
80111b87ad7e.plain: Whenever this model makes a ranged attack against an enemy unit and scores a hit, then for the rest of the phase, any hit roll of 1 is re-rolled for ranged attacks that your other NECRONS models make against that enemy unit.

82527f096715.name: Empyric Damping
82527f096715.plain: In your opponent's Psychic phase, when an enemy PSYKER tries to manifest a psychic power within 18" of one of your SZAREKHAN units: roll a D6; on a 4+, that power is denied.

8657ac1cf9d0.name: Implacable Conqueror (Aura)
8657ac1cf9d0.plain: Aura: you can re-roll charge rolls for your <DYNASTY> CORE units while they are within 6" of this WARLORD.

873c9e0e44e2.name: Preservative Auto-Torpor
873c9e0e44e2.plain: While Szarekh has 8 or fewer wounds left, it can't attack with its Staff of Stars and it loses the Phaeron of the Stars ability. While it has 4 or fewer wounds left, it also can't attack with its Scythe of Dust and it loses the Phaeron of the Blades ability.

886f3c6f42f2.name: Secondary Objective - Code of Combat
886f3c6f42f2.plain:
Purge the Enemy: when the battle ends, score:
- 3 victory points per enemy unit destroyed during the battle by a ranged attack from your NECRONS NOBLE units.
- 4 victory points per enemy unit destroyed during the battle by a melee attack from your NECRONS NOBLE units.

Also, each time a melee attack by one of your NECRONS NOBLE units destroys an enemy CHARACTER unit, you gain 1 Command point.

89592a22eb81.name: Guardian Protocols
89592a22eb81.plain: Even if this unit has fewer than 3 models, a NOBLE unit of yours can benefit from the Look Out, Sir rule while it is within 3" of this unit, as long as it is a <DYNASTY> INFANTRY NOBLE or DYNASTIC AGENT INFANTRY NOBLE unit.

8ab2f6165fa2.name: Canoptek Control Node
8ab2f6165fa2.plain: Aura: while one of your <DYNASTY> CANOPTEK units is within 6" of the bearer, add 1 to the hit roll of every attack its models make. The bearer gains this as its Control Node (Aura) ability.

8adabc7a0dce.name: Secondary Objective - Purge the Vermin
8adabc7a0dce.plain:
Battlefield Supremacy: when your turn ends, score:
- 1 victory point per table quarter with no enemy units (other than AIRCRAFT units) wholly within it.
- 1 victory point if no enemy units (other than AIRCRAFT units) are wholly within your deployment zone.

8b7cfb1acf0c.name: Convergence of Dominion
8b7cfb1acf0c.plain: The first time this unit is set up on the battlefield, its models don't need to be in unit coherency; instead, every model must be set up wholly within 12" of another model from its unit. From then on, treat each model in this unit as a separate unit.

8cb16ef8af1b.name: Obeisance Generators
8cb16ef8af1b.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, any enemy units within Engagement Range of Szarekh can't fight this phase until every other eligible unit from your army has fought.

8d5639e6f063.name: Tomb Guardians
8d5639e6f063.plain: This unit never gets a Dynastic Code. Each model in this unit has 1 extra attack. You can re-roll any Reanimation Protocol roll of 1 for this unit.

8f4cb6f7e943.name: Rites of Reanimation
8f4cb6f7e943.plain: In your Command phase, you can choose one of your <DYNASTY> CORE units that is within 6" of this model. One of that unit's destroyed models is Reanimated, or D3 of them if it is a NECRON WARRIORS unit. No unit can be chosen for this ability more than once per phase.

9059aa7cc0fd.name: Spear of the Void Dragon (Melee)
9059aa7cc0fd.plain: This weapon's Damage characteristic becomes D3+3 for any of its attacks that are allocated to a VEHICLE model.

9154e5e34088.name: Aeonstave (Shooting)
9154e5e34088.plain: Blast. Your opponent can't use invulnerable saves against attacks made with this weapon.

9214531fefce.name: Secondary Objective - The Treasures of Aeons
9214531fefce.plain:
No Mercy, No Respite secondary objective: score victory points at the end of your turn for controlling objective markers your opponent chose. After both sides have deployed, your opponent picks 3 objective markers on the battlefield. At the end of your turn, if you control 1 or more of them, score:
- 2 victory points for 1 marker.
- 3 victory points for 2 markers.
- 5 victory points for 3 markers.

92bbcdd32884.name: Thrall of the Silent King
92bbcdd32884.plain: This WARLORD's aura abilities get 3" more range, up to a maximum of 9". This WARLORD's My Will Be Done, The Lord's Will and Adaptive Strategy abilities can pick one of your <DYNASTY> CORE units within 12" of it, instead of 9".

94541a1589c0.name: Solar Pulse
94541a1589c0.plain: In your Shooting phase: pick one enemy unit. Until the phase ends, it doesn't get the benefits of cover against ranged attacks made by models in your NECRONS units.

947cdeb3faeb.name: Dynastic Advisors
947cdeb3faeb.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, then for every CRYPTEK unit (other than DYNASTIC AGENTS units) in a Detachment that also has at least one NOBLE unit, you can include a second CRYPTEK unit (also not a DYNASTIC AGENTS unit) in that Detachment without using up an extra Battlefield Role slot.

97107028e78a.name: Tunnelling Horrors
97107028e78a.plain: During deployment, you can place this unit underground rather than on the battlefield. If you do, in the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases you can set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy models.

9788236e2d58.name: The Lord's Will
9788236e2d58.plain: In your Command phase, you can choose one of your <DYNASTY> CORE units that is within 9" of this model. Until your next Command phase begins, re-roll any hit roll of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

99e8dab98d9b.name: Command Protocols - Protocol of the Hungry Void
99e8dab98d9b.plain:
Directive 1: an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a melee attack by a model in this unit improves that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.
Directive 2: add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee attacks made by this unit's models if the unit has made a charge move, been charged or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn.

9b3cca5e24af.name: Blood Scythe
9b3cca5e24af.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 2 extra attacks with this weapon. This Relic takes the place of a warscythe or voidscythe.

9b5a00976343.name: Curator of Deadly Curiosities
9b5a00976343.plain:
Pick one weapon (not a Relic) this WARLORD has when you choose this trait, and for that weapon:
- improve its Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.
- add 1 to its Strength and Damage characteristics.

9c0b33a04e3d.name: Dimensional Destabilisation
9c0b33a04e3d.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, after one of your C'TAN SHARD models has used a Power of the C'tan: roll a D6, and that model can immediately use the matching power from the Powers of the C'tan, even if that power has already been used this turn. This Stratagem costs 2CP if the model has the TITANIC keyword, or 1CP if it does not.

9c280a88dbf6.name: Dimensional Corridor
9c280a88dbf6.plain: At the start of your Movement phase: pick one of your <DYNASTY> CORE INFANTRY units that is on the battlefield and remove it. In the Reinforcements step of this phase, set it up again anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of one of your <DYNASTY> MONOLITH models and more than 9" away from all enemy models.

9c36efa9db98.name: Conductor of Legions
9c36efa9db98.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your CULT OF THE CRYPTEK units within 9" of this WARLORD: its ranged attacks won't make its action fail. This lasts until the start of your next Command phase.

9cbdd77a2a5a.name: Dynastic Agents and Star Gods
9cbdd77a2a5a.plain: Putting DYNASTIC AGENT and C'TAN SHARD units in a NECRONS Detachment doesn't prevent that Detachment's other units from gaining a Dynastic Code. No DYNASTIC AGENT or C'TAN SHARD unit ever gains a Dynastic Code. Each NECRONS Detachment in your army can include no more than one C'TAN SHARD model.

9d5369a803ac.name: Rad-Wreathed (Aura)
9d5369a803ac.plain: Aura: while an enemy unit (other than a VEHICLE unit) is within 1" of this unit, its models' Toughness characteristic is reduced by 1.

9dbc7cafd632.name: Dynastic Command Node
9dbc7cafd632.plain: While your army has an active command protocol, your units that have the Command Protocols ability and are within 6" of this model benefit from the directive(s) selected for it.

9dbf06f2160c.name: Relentless March (Necrons) (Aura)
9dbf06f2160c.plain: Aura: while one of your NECRONS CORE units is within 6" of this model, whenever that unit is picked to make a Normal Move or Advance, its models' Move characteristic goes up by 1" until the phase ends.

9dc0fa1979fa.name: Chariot of the Hierarchs
9dc0fa1979fa.plain:
The bearer:
- can't be wounded by an attack on an unmodified wound roll of 1-3, whatever abilities the attacking weapon or model has.
- can move an extra 3" each time it piles in or consolidates.

9e47e705a136.name: Harbinger of Destruction
9e47e705a136.plain: When your Movement phase ends, if this model did not Fall Back in it, roll three D6s: each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the closest enemy unit within 24" of this model that it can see.

a00c6aef58b0.name: Mind in the Machine
a00c6aef58b0.plain: At the start of your Shooting phase, you can pick one enemy VEHICLE model within 12" of this model that it can see, and roll 3D6 (or 2D6 if that model is TITANIC). If the total equals or beats the selected model's Leadership characteristic, you can shoot one of its ranged weapons as though it were a unit from your army, using this model's Ballistic Skill characteristic rather than the target model's.

a1428e858512.name: United in Destruction (Aura)
a1428e858512.plain: Aura: while one of your <DYNASTY> DESTROYER CULT units is within 6" of this model, re-roll any wound roll of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

a26b12068a45.name: Powers of the C'tan (Vault)
a26b12068a45.plain: From the Powers of the C'tan, this model knows four C'tan Powers. If it neither Advanced nor Fell Back during your Movement phase, then at the end of that phase it can use as many C'tan Powers it knows as this table shows: 3 Powers at 16+ Wounds, 2 Powers at 9-15 Wounds, 1 Power at 1-8 Wounds. It may never use any one C'tan Power twice in a turn.

a3619f3c280c.name: Stellar Alignment Protocol
a3619f3c280c.plain: In the Command phase: pick one of your NECRONS VEHICLE models whose Wounds characteristic is 10 or more. Until your next Command phase starts, when working out which characteristics on its profile to use, treat it as if it had all of its wounds remaining. This Stratagem costs 2CP if the model has the TITANIC keyword, or 1CP if it does not.

a433491522c4.name: My Will Be Done
a433491522c4.plain: In your Command phase, this model can choose one of your NECRONS CORE units that is within 9" of it. Add 1 to the hit roll of each attack made by a model in the chosen unit until your next Command phase begins. No unit can be chosen for this ability more than once per phase.

a56c5a5bfd25.name: Atavindicator
a56c5a5bfd25.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, pick one enemy unit within 18" of the bearer; it takes D3 mortal wounds if a 3D6 roll equals or beats its Leadership. You can't pick a VEHICLE unit.

a62f07facb26.name: Command Protocols - Protocol of the Vengeful Stars
a62f07facb26.plain:
Directive 1: an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a ranged attack by a model in this unit improves that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.
Directive 2: when a model in this unit makes a ranged attack against a unit within half range, the target gets no benefit from cover to its saving throw against that attack.

a69270ad44c0.name: Interplanetary Invaders
a69270ad44c0.plain: VEHICLE units with this code can shoot in a turn in which they Fell Back; if they do, subtract 1 from their ranged attacks' hit rolls until the end of the turn. VEHICLE models with this code also ignore the hit roll penalty for shooting Heavy weapons while their unit is within Engagement Range of enemy units.

a802ed00b375.name: Stalking Annihilator
a802ed00b375.plain: In your Shooting phase: pick one of your CANOPTEK DOOMSTALKER models that made a Normal Move or Fell Back this turn. It can shoot this turn, and when it does, you can use the high power profile of its doomsday blaster even though it didn't Remain Stationary this turn.

a85f23be4a0c.name: Awakened By Murder
a85f23be4a0c.plain: Units with this code add 1 to their charge rolls. When a model with this code makes a melee attack, improve that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 if the model's unit has made a charge move, been charged or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn. If all the units in your army (not counting DYNASTIC AGENT and C'TAN SHARD units) have this code, you can pick both directives of the Protocol of the Hungry Void, not just one, whenever it becomes active for your army.

a87b385a9e5b.name: Annihilation Protocols
a87b385a9e5b.plain:
This unit can benefit from this ability, and the rules below apply, if your army is an Annihilation Legion and your WARLORD is a SKORPEKH LORD or LOKHUST LORD model.

Once both sides have deployed, and before you determine who takes the first turn, you must secretly give each of the first five battle rounds its own different annihilation protocol and note this on your army roster.

At the start of every battle round, if at least one SKORPEKH LORD or LOKHUST LORD unit from your army is on the battlefield, the annihilation protocol assigned to that round becomes active for your army until that round ends. Every annihilation protocol has two directives. When one becomes active, show it to your opponent and choose one of its directives. For as long as that protocol stays active, each unit eligible for this ability gets the benefit of the chosen directive while it is within 6" of one of your SKORPEKH LORD or LOKHUST LORD models.

If the battle goes on past the fifth battle round, the annihilation protocol that was active in the fifth battle round stays active for the rest of the battle.

a893e901c682.name: Cortical Subjugator Scarabs
a893e901c682.plain: Once per battle, when the Heroic Interventions step of your opponent's Charge phase begins, you may choose one of your <DYNASTY> units within 6" of the bearer. Unless it is within Engagement Range of any enemy units, that unit can perform a Heroic Intervention as though it were a CHARACTER.

a8a3583ecf33.name: Countertemporal Nanomines
a8a3583ecf33.plain: In your Shooting phase, you may choose an enemy unit within 18" of the bearer. Advance rolls and charge rolls for that unit are halved until your next turn starts.

a9026a97492e.name: Gravity Pulse
a9026a97492e.plain: In your Shooting phase, you can pick one enemy unit within 24" of this model that can FLY. For its models, halve the Move characteristic until your next Shooting phase starts. If the picked unit is an AIRCRAFT, roll 2D6: it takes 1 mortal wound for each point by which the total is higher than its Toughness characteristic. A unit can't be picked for this ability more than once per phase.

a98179d7455c.name: Whirling Onslaught
a98179d7455c.plain: In any phase, when one of your SKORPEKH DESTROYERS or SKORPEKH LORD units is picked as the target of an attack: until the phase ends, subtract 1 from the wound roll of every attack made against that unit.

aa9892933a51.name: Inspiring Leader (Aura)
aa9892933a51.plain: Aura: your units add 1 to their Leadership characteristic while they are within 6" of this WARLORD.

aba8919bc237.name: Relentlessly Expansionist
aba8919bc237.plain: Units with this code can each make a Normal Move of up to 6" when the first battle round starts, before any turn has begun.

ac3f4cd70e6b.name: Command Protocols - Protocol of the Undying Legions
ac3f4cd70e6b.plain:
Directive 1: whenever this unit uses its Living Metal ability, each of its models gets back 1 extra lost wound.
Directive 2: when making Reanimation Protocol rolls for this unit, you may re-roll one of the dice.

ad0c5c197a71.name: Fluid Necrodermis
ad0c5c197a71.plain:
For this WARLORD:
- you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic, Advance rolls and charge rolls.
- the first time in each turn that a saving throw is failed for it, change that attack's Damage characteristic to 0.

ae8366e4a11a.name: Mask of Obliteration
ae8366e4a11a.plain: If the bearer hits with this profile, make one wound roll against the target unit and one against each other unit a straight line passes over or through. Draw that line from the nearest point of this model's base to the nearest point of the closest target model's base (or hull).

afc88ffeea20.name: Power Crucible Terrain Features
afc88ffeea20.plain: The Power Crucible counts as a terrain feature with the Unstable Position, Dense Cover and Obscuring terrain traits.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Rules"

b046d54468f7.name: Arkana: Aurorocular Mantle
b046d54468f7.plain: Aura: while one of your CULT OF THE CRYPTEK units is within 6" of the bearer, targets of its models' attacks don't get the benefits of cover. The bearer gains this as its Aurorocular Mantle (Aura) ability. Only a TECHNOMANCER model with a canoptek cloak can have this.

b0a0aca37059.name: Titanic Forelimbs (Reaping Sweep)
b0a0aca37059.plain: For every attack made with this weapon, make 2 hit rolls.

b1236327b0e9.name: Master Chronomancer
b1236327b0e9.plain: In your Command phase, you can choose one of your NECRONS units that is within 9" of this model. Until your next Command phase begins, the chosen unit's models have a 5+ invulnerable save and you can re-roll its charge rolls.

b1acb2c36c46.name: Dominion Protocols (Aura)
b1acb2c36c46.plain: Aura: while one of your <DYNASTY> CORE units is within 6" of this model, its models add 2 to their Leadership characteristic.

b1d6f0c24edb.name: Entropic Strike
b1d6f0c24edb.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your C'TAN SHARD models is picked to fight: until the phase ends, invulnerable saves can't be taken against its melee attacks.

b210f2c43175.name: Relentless Onslaught
b210f2c43175.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your CORE INFANTRY units is picked to shoot: until the phase ends, whenever a model in it uses a Rapid Fire weapon to attack, each unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 extra hit.

b25b1e3ac835.name: Aggression Overrides
b25b1e3ac835.plain: In your Command phase: choose one of your CANOPTEK SPYDERS units. Until your next Command phase starts, its models add 2" to their Move characteristic and their Weapon Skill characteristic becomes 2+.

b27be2f08c47.name: Techno-oracular Targeting
b27be2f08c47.plain: In your Shooting phase, before you make the wound roll for an attack by one of your NECRONS models: skip that wound roll, and the attack wounds the target automatically.

b2c37cf4247f.name: Canoptek Reinforcement
b2c37cf4247f.plain: Once per battle, in the Reinforcement step of your Movement phase: pick one of your CANOPTEK PLASMACYTE units that has been destroyed. Put it back on the battlefield, anywhere within 3" of one of your DESTROYER CULT units but not within Engagement Range of any enemy models.

b3d8f96821d7.name: Immovable Phalanx
b3d8f96821d7.plain: INFANTRY models with this code add 1 to armour saving throws against attacks with a Damage characteristic of 1. This doesn't apply if, this battle round, the model's unit made a Normal Move, Advanced or Fell Back.

b3fad0de95c5.name: Surrogate Hosts
b3fad0de95c5.plain: When this model is destroyed, you can choose to roll a D6 after removing it, instead of using any other rule that triggers when a model is destroyed. On a 2+, you can choose another of your NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER models on the battlefield (not a named character). Remove that model as though it were destroyed (no rules that trigger on a model being destroyed can be used), then put this model back into play in the spot the removed model occupied, with 3 wounds left.

b5407ec04a6a.name: A Moment of Clarity
b5407ec04a6a.plain: In your Command phase: choose one of your ANNIHILATION LEGION units. It has the Objective Secured ability until your next Command phase starts.

b8c51f99c0a3.name: Phaeron of the Blades (Aura)
b8c51f99c0a3.plain: Aura: while one of your NECRONS CORE or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS units is within 6" of Szarekh, you can re-roll the wound roll for each melee attack made by a model in that unit.

b8dd490b98ea.name: Infinity Mantle
b8dd490b98ea.plain: The bearer adds 1 to its armour saving throws. Whenever it would lose a wound, roll one D6, and on a 6 it doesn't lose that wound.

b960f9e49bf9.name: Scarab Hive
b960f9e49bf9.plain: In your Command phase, each of your <DYNASTY> CANOPTEK SCARAB SWARM units within 6" of this unit has one of its destroyed models Reanimated. No unit can be affected by this ability more than once per phase.

bb039b4f2230.name: Cleaving Counterblow
bb039b4f2230.plain: If a melee attack destroys this model, leave it in play: once the attacking model's unit has finished its attacks, this model fights as though it were the Fight phase, and is then removed from play.

bb4fbae52e91.name: Hardwired for Destruction
bb4fbae52e91.plain: Re-roll any hit roll of 1 for attacks made by this model.

bca499600b2f.name: Superior Artisans
bca499600b2f.plain: Each time a unit with this code is picked to shoot or fight, one of the wound rolls for those attacks can be re-rolled.

bcd0d481a4e7.name: Butchers
bcd0d481a4e7.plain: Units with this code add 1 to their charge rolls.

bd5c7caf0922.name: Powers of the C'tan (Nightbringer)
bd5c7caf0922.plain: Besides the Gaze of Death C'tan Power, this model knows one more power chosen from the Powers of the C'tan. If it neither Advanced nor Fell Back during your Movement phase, it can use two different C'tan Powers it knows at the end of that phase; it can't use any one C'tan Power more than once per turn.

be19de7f0251.name: Empathic Obliterator
be19de7f0251.plain: Whenever an attack with this weapon destroys a CHARACTER model, every enemy unit within 6" of the bearer takes D3 mortal wounds.

c0b19d0a4506.name: Judgement of the Triarch
c0b19d0a4506.plain: When a TRIARCH unit is picked to shoot in your Shooting phase, or picked to fight in the Fight phase: until the phase ends, add 1 to the hit roll of every attack made by a model in that unit.

c1642ab8c8c7.name: Burrowing Nightmares
c1642ab8c8c7.plain: At the start of your Movement phase: pick one of your OPHYDIAN DESTROYERS units that is on the battlefield and take it off the battlefield. During your next Movement phase's Reinforcements step, you may set it back up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy models. If it is still not on the battlefield when the battle ends, it is destroyed.

c2a09a406dff.name: Hovering Sentinel
c2a09a406dff.plain: If this model Remains Stationary during your Movement phase, its tesla spheres change until your next Movement phase starts: their Type becomes Assault 6, their Strength characteristic becomes 8 and their Damage characteristic becomes 2.

c37229717aa0.name: Arkana: Atomiser Stave
c37229717aa0.plain: Whenever you use the bearer's Harbinger of Destruction ability, you roll 6 D6 instead of the usual 3 dice. Only a PLASMANCER model can have this.

c394f872e5ab.name: Secondary Objective - Ancient Machineries
c394f872e5ab.plain:
Shadow Operations secondary objective: score 4 victory points each time one of your units completes the Awaken Ancient Machinery action.

Awaken Ancient Machinery (Action): one of your NECRONS CORE or NECRONS CANOPTEK units can start this action at the end of your Movement phase, if it is in range of an objective marker that you control, that is outside your deployment zone and that your army has not already awakened. A unit with the Objective Secured ability completes the action at the end of your turn; any other unit completes it at the start of your next Command phase or when the battle ends, whichever comes first. Either way, it is only completed if the unit is still in range of the same objective marker. Once the action is completed, your army has awakened that objective marker.

c41590f64152.name: Antimatter Meteor
c41590f64152.plain: Roll one D6 and deal mortal wounds to the closest enemy unit within 24" that this C'TAN SHARD can see: 3 on a 3-5, or D3+3 on a 6+. If this C'TAN SHARD is a TESSERACT VAULT, add 1 to the roll.

c4936808a8cb.name: Noctilith Beacons
c4936808a8cb.plain: During your opponent's Psychic phase, Szarekh can try to deny a single psychic power, as though he were a PSYKER.

c5378ceb40e1.name: Isolationists
c5378ceb40e1.plain: When a model with this code attacks a unit within 12" with a Rapid Fire weapon, add 1 to that attack's Strength characteristic.

c56a56a5aa11.name: Translocation Protocols
c56a56a5aa11.plain: While at least one STARSTELE unit from your army is on the battlefield, your CRYPTEK units can attempt this action: 'Activate Translocation Protocols (Action): one of your CRYPTEK units that is within 3" of any of your STARSTELE units can start this action at the end of your Movement phase. It is completed at the end of your turn. When it is completed, pick one of those STARSTELE units and take it off the battlefield; then set that STARSTELE unit back up during the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy models. If that STARSTELE unit is not on the battlefield when the battle ends, it is destroyed.'

c5f0e6b0187b.name: Multi-Threat Eliminator
c5f0e6b0187b.plain: Whenever a ranged attack made with this model's enmitic disintegrator pistols destroys an enemy model, this model can shoot one of its enmitic disintegrator pistols one more time after it has made the rest of its attacks. Those extra attacks can't generate further attacks.

c60a6a65daf4.name: Powers of the C'tan (Void Dragon)
c60a6a65daf4.plain: Besides the Voltaic Storm C'tan Power, this model knows one more power chosen from the Powers of the C'tan. If it neither Advanced nor Fell Back during your Movement phase, it can use two different C'tan Powers it knows at the end of that phase; it can't use any one C'tan Power more than once per turn.

c7c0522e28b9.name: Writhing Worldscape
c7c0522e28b9.plain: When your Movement phase starts, roll one D6 for every enemy unit in Engagement Range of this model; each one you roll a 4+ for suffers 1 mortal wound. Also, whenever a unit declares a charge against this model, subtract 2 from that unit's charge rolls until the end of the phase.

c81f971c54c3.name: Hyperphase Impalement
c81f971c54c3.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your OPHYDIAN DESTROYERS units is picked to fight: until that fight is resolved, whenever a model in it makes a melee attack, no rules that ignore wounds can be used.

c82a5a822012.name: Talent for Annihilation
c82a5a822012.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your MEPHRIT units is picked to shoot: until the phase ends, whenever a model in it attacks, an unmodified wound roll of 6 deals 1 mortal wound to the target on top of any normal damage (no more than 3 mortal wounds per phase can be dealt through this Stratagem).

ca61d23f5258.name: Annihilation Protocols
ca61d23f5258.plain: A summary of the Annihilation Protocols appears at the bottom of the list output.

cb27f3797dcf.name: The Unmerciful Horde
cb27f3797dcf.plain: You can re-roll Morale tests taken for units with this code.

cb3cc4f505ea.name: Blood Rites
cb3cc4f505ea.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your NOVOKH units is picked to fight: its models add 1 to their Attacks characteristic until the phase ends.

cb690b52c2e8.name: Drain Life
cb690b52c2e8.plain: When an enemy model has a melee attack from this model allocated to it, that enemy model can't use any rules to ignore the wounds it loses.

cbe8a3cadda8.name: Hyperlogical Strategist
cbe8a3cadda8.plain: While this WARLORD is on the battlefield, whenever you spend a Command point on a Stratagem, you can roll one D6: on a 5+, you get that Command point back.

cc30255f1444.name: Doomsday Blaster (High Power)
cc30255f1444.plain: Blast. The bearer can attack with this profile only if it Remained Stationary in its previous Movement phase.

ccededf77c7b.name: Gun Emplacement Mount Terrain Features
ccededf77c7b.plain: The Gun Emplacement Mounts count as terrain features with the Unstable Position, Dense Cover and Obscuring terrain traits.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Rules"

cd5297583775.name: Hyperphase Reap-Blades
cd5297583775.plain: Whenever a model in this unit attacks with a hyperphase reap-blade, each unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 extra hit.

cda4117c3ba6.name: Master of the Cult
cda4117c3ba6.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your CULT OF THE CRYPTEK units within 9" of this WARLORD to add 1 to its hit rolls. This lasts until the start of your next Command phase and applies to every attack made by a model in that unit.

cdfad4127f2f.name: Photonic Transubjector
cdfad4127f2f.plain: Once per turn, the first time the bearer fails a saving throw, the Damage characteristic of that attack becomes 0.

ce388244766a.name: The Lord's Will (Sautekh)
ce388244766a.plain: In your Command phase, you can choose one of your SAUTEKH CORE units that is within 9" of this model. Until your next Command phase begins, re-roll any hit roll of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

ceae3510c727.name: Untamed Power
ceae3510c727.plain: This model's Attacks characteristic is 6 and its Strength characteristic is 7.

cec4a8a22490.name: Arkana: Entropic Chronoshackle
cec4a8a22490.plain: CHRONOMANCER model only: at the start of your opponent's Movement phase, you can pick one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer and roll a D6. On a 4+, that enemy unit can't be picked to Fall Back until the phase ends.

cf07b9a49f3e.name: Mechanical Augmentation
cf07b9a49f3e.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, you can pick one of your NECRONS CORE units within 6" of this model. If you do, roll a D3 and check the table below. No unit can be picked for this ability more than once per battle.

cf0daa1819b9.name: Weaponised Bodies
cf0daa1819b9.plain: In your Charge phase, when one of your DESTROYER CULT units finishes a charge move: pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it. For every model of that DESTROYER CULT unit within Engagement Range of the chosen enemy unit, roll as many D6 as its Wounds characteristic. Each 5+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the enemy unit, up to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.

cf1222997b27.name: Command Protocols - Protocol of the Conquering Tyrant
cf1222997b27.plain:
Directive 1: this unit's aura abilities, and its Lord's Will, My Will Be Done and Rites of Reanimation abilities, get 3" more range (to a maximum of 12").
Directive 2: this unit can shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back; if it does, subtract 1 from the hit rolls of its models' ranged attacks until the end of the turn.

cfdba9bf3a2b.name: Ghostwalk Mantle
cfdba9bf3a2b.plain: At the start of your Movement phase, you can take this model off the battlefield. If you do, in the Reinforcements step of that phase, set it up again anywhere on the battlefield within 3" of one of your NEMESOR ZAHNDREKH models.

d137c18fe1d3.name: Nightmare Shroud (Aura)
d137c18fe1d3.plain: Aura: while an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, its models subtract 1 from their Leadership characteristic, and 1 is also subtracted from Combat Attrition tests taken for that unit.

d242ff30ee75.name: Lurking Murderers
d242ff30ee75.plain: At the start of the Fight phase: pick one of your FLAYED ONES units that is wholly within an Area Terrain feature. Until the phase ends, you can re-roll the wound roll for every attack made by a model in that unit. This Stratagem costs 2CP if the unit has 11 or more models, or 1CP if it does not.

d36f5cd30a9f.name: Codifier of Lesser Beings
d36f5cd30a9f.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your CULT OF THE CRYPTEK units within 6" of this WARLORD and one enemy unit this WARLORD can see. Until the start of your next Command phase, you can add 1 to the wound roll of each attack that CULT OF THE CRYPTEK unit makes against that enemy unit.

d57981ac894e.name: Warrior Nobles
d57981ac894e.plain: NOBLE models with this code re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1 for their melee attacks.

d593609e13e0.name: Cosmic Fire
d593609e13e0.plain: Each enemy unit within 9" of this C'TAN SHARD suffers D3 mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+ (roll separately for each unit). If this C'TAN SHARD is a TESSERACT VAULT, those units suffer 3 mortal wounds instead of D3.

d5f4338590c1.name: Necron Secondary Objectives
d5f4338590c1.plain: A summary of the Necron secondary objectives appears at the bottom of the list output.

d667afde1265.name: Reanimation Prioritisation
d667afde1265.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when one of your NECRONS units is picked as the target of an attack: choose a CANOPTEK REANIMATOR model from your army within 6" of the targeted unit and visible to it. As though it were your Command phase, that model can use its Nanoscarab Reanimation Beam ability, picking the targeted unit to be healed by its beam (if any other unit was being healed by that model's reanimation beam, it stops being healed by it).

d71607f1915a.name: Enhanced Gloom Prism
d71607f1915a.plain: When one of your CANOPTEK SPYDERS units is about to take a Deny the Witch test in your opponent's Psychic phase: add 2 to the test's result.

d74b2c87f585.name: Infused Madness
d74b2c87f585.plain: Once per turn, at the start of your Charge phase or of the Fight phase, you can pick one of your <DYNASTY> DESTROYER CULT units within 3" of this model. If you do, roll a D6: on a 1, one model in that unit is destroyed. Whatever the roll, until the end of the turn, models in that unit add 1 to their Strength and Attacks characteristics. No unit can be picked for this ability more than once per turn.

d879145324bc.name: Triarchal Menhir
d879145324bc.plain: While this unit has any Triarchal Menhirs models, it doesn't count as a CHARACTER for the Look Out, Sir rule, and any attack that successfully wounds this unit must be allocated to one of those models. Ignore destroyed Triarchal Menhirs for Morale tests. If Szarekh is ever destroyed, any Triarchal Menhirs left in this unit are destroyed too.

d9005a71e1df.name: Eternity Gate
d9005a71e1df.plain: In your Movement phase, if this model Remains Stationary, it can summon a unit in the Reinforcement step of that phase. If it does, pick one of your <DYNASTY> CORE INFANTRY units that is in Strategic Reserves and set it up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this model, but not within Engagement Range of any enemy models.
