Any model in a unit set up this way counts as having moved, in the Movement phase, as many inches as its Move characteristic.

d93a800dbf6d.name: Relentless March (Sautekh) (Aura)
d93a800dbf6d.plain: Aura: while one of your SAUTEKH CORE units is within 6" of this model, whenever that unit is picked to make a Normal Move or Advance, its models' Move characteristic goes up by 1" until the phase ends.

d957b6edd286.name: Canoptek Cloak
d957b6edd286.plain: The bearer's Move characteristic is 10" and it has the FLY keyword. Also, at the end of your Movement phase, you can repair one of your <DYNASTY> models within 3" of this model, which gets back up to D3 lost wounds. No model can be repaired more than once per turn.

d978c436fd6e.name: Lord of the Pyrrhian Legions (Aura)
d978c436fd6e.plain: Aura: while one of your NECRONS CORE units is within 6" of this model, each model in that unit gets 1 extra attack.

daab4467ad13.name: Counter Tactics
daab4467ad13.plain: Once per battle, this model can engage its counter tactics when your opponent declares they will use a Stratagem during a battle round, before they spend any Command points on it. If it does, your opponent can't use that Stratagem during this battle round.

db36aeb71d72.name: Airborne
db36aeb71d72.plain: This model can't declare a charge, and only a unit that can FLY can pick it as a charge target. It can fight only while it is within Engagement Range of enemy units that can FLY, and it can make melee attacks only against units that can FLY. Enemy units can make melee attacks against it only if they can FLY.

db837ae03357.name: Canoptek Overdrive
db837ae03357.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your CANOPTEK WRAITHS models is destroyed: until the phase ends, whenever a melee attack destroys a model in this unit that has not fought this phase, don't remove it yet. It can fight once the attacking model's unit has finished its attacks, and is removed afterwards.

dc013a008b36.name: Quantum Orb
dc013a008b36.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, the bearer may activate this Cryptek Arkana item. When it does, choose a point anywhere on the battlefield within 24" of the bearer and put a marker there. When your next Command phase starts, roll a D6 for each unit within 6" of the marker's centre, subtracting 1 from the roll for a CHARACTER unit. A 4-5 inflicts D3 mortal wounds on that unit, and a 6 inflicts 3 mortal wounds. Then remove the marker.

dc5faf8dbc6e.name: Flesh Hunger
dc5faf8dbc6e.plain: Melee attacks by models in this unit against enemy units other than VEHICLE units score 1 extra hit on each unmodified hit roll of 6.

e09e8138919b.name: Eternal Engines
e09e8138919b.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your MAYNARKH VEHICLE units within 6" of this model. When it uses its Living Metal ability this phase, it gets back up to D3 lost wounds rather than 1.

e183f221342a.name: Relentless Advance
e183f221342a.plain: You can re-roll Morale tests taken for units with this code. When a model with this code shoots a Rapid Fire weapon at a target within 18", it makes double the number of attacks, instead of using the normal Rapid Fire rules. If all the units in your army (not counting DYNASTIC AGENT and C'TAN SHARD units) have this code, you can pick both directives of the Protocol of the Conquering Tyrant, not just one, whenever it becomes active for your army.

e19ba2618511.name: Hand of the Phaeron
e19ba2618511.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if it has no model with the PHAERON keyword: pick one NECRONS OVERLORD model from your army (not a named character). It gains the PHAERON keyword, and it can use its My Will Be Done ability one extra time in your Command phase. You can use this Stratagem only once.

e1c9a1372901.name: Prismatic Dimensional Breach
e1c9a1372901.plain: In the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase: pick one of your <DYNASTY> CORE units that is in Strategic Reserves, then pick one of your <DYNASTY> NIGHT SCYTHE or <DYNASTY> MONOLITH models on the battlefield. Set up the CORE unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of the NIGHT SCYTHE or MONOLITH model and not in Engagement Range of any enemy units. You can't use this Stratagem in the first battle round.

e32aceda45ff.name: Uncanny Artificers
e32aceda45ff.plain: Whenever a model with this code would lose a wound because of a mortal wound, roll one D6: on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound. Whenever a unit with this code is picked to shoot or fight, one wound roll for that unit's attacks can be re-rolled. If all the units in your army (not counting DYNASTIC AGENT and C'TAN SHARD units) have this code, you can pick both directives of the Protocol of the Undying Legions, not just one, whenever it becomes active for your army.

e3c252640f94.name: Voice of the Triarch
e3c252640f94.plain: Once per battle, at the start of any battle round, Szarekh can alter your command protocols if he is on the battlefield. If he does, then for that battle round, a command protocol you didn't assign to any battle round before the battle becomes active for your army in place of the one you did assign to it.

e3f89920d118.name: Severed
e3f89920d118.plain: Units with this code get your active command protocol's selected directive within 9" of any of your NECRONS CHARACTER models, instead of 6". C'TAN SHARD models don't count for this.

e401794a9d15.name: Swift Dismemberment
e401794a9d15.plain: In your Charge phase: pick one of your DESTROYER CULT units. Until the end of the turn, it can charge even though it Advanced this turn.

e52f9e190ebe.name: Quantum Shielding
e52f9e190ebe.plain: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save. Also, whenever an attack targets this model, an unmodified wound roll of 1-3 always fails, whatever abilities the weapon or attacker has.

e5512c7b993e.name: Infomonger
e5512c7b993e.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your CULT OF THE CRYPTEK units within 6" of this WARLORD to get both directives of the active command protocol. This lasts until the end of the battle round.

e568bf6bb40d.name: Cult of Annihilation
e568bf6bb40d.plain:
With this rule:
- every DESTROYER CULT unit in your army gains the Cult of Annihilation ability and the Annihilation Protocols.
- this unit can never gain a Dynastic Code.
- when a model with this ability makes an attack against a unit that was below its Starting Strength at the time this model was picked to shoot or fight, add 1 to the attack's hit roll.
- add 1 to the wound roll of an attack made by a model with this ability if the target was below Half-strength at the time this model was picked to shoot or fight.

e5c1973f08fc.name: Spear of the Void Dragon (Shooting)
e5c1973f08fc.plain: Whenever an attack with this weapon scores a hit, draw a straight line from the closest point of this model's base (or hull) to the closest point of the nearest model in the target unit. Roll to wound once against the target unit, and once against each other unit the line crosses. This weapon's Damage characteristic becomes D3+3 for any of its attacks allocated to a VEHICLE model.

e5dfca6d2b5d.name: Viral Construct
e5dfca6d2b5d.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, each <DYNASTY> DESTROYER CULT unit in a Detachment lets you include one <DYNASTY> CANOPTEK PLASMACYTE unit in that Detachment without using up a Battlefield Role slot. A Detachment can't contain more <DYNASTY> CANOPTEK PLASMACYTE units than it has <DYNASTY> DESTROYER CULT units.

e778f624f410.name: Vengeance of the Enchained
e778f624f410.plain: When Szarekh is destroyed, roll a D6 before you remove it. On a 4+, it explodes and every unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

e7aaa6a8c994.name: My Will Be Done
e7aaa6a8c994.plain: In your Command phase, this model can choose one of your SAUTEKH CORE units that is within 9" of it. Add 1 to the hit roll of each attack made by a model in the chosen unit until your next Command phase begins. No unit can be chosen for this ability more than once per phase.

e7d8bf243267.name: My Will Be Done (Silent King)
e7d8bf243267.plain: In your Command phase, Szarekh can choose one of your NECRONS CORE or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS units that is within 9" of him. Add 1 to the hit roll of each attack made by a model in the chosen unit until your next Command phase begins. No unit can be chosen for this ability more than once per phase.

e80a613d0318.name: Strange Echoes
e80a613d0318.plain: In your Command phase: pick one of your C'TAN SHARD models, and choose a power from the Powers of the C'tan that it doesn't know. That power takes the place of one of the Powers of the C'tan it does know.

e96ca58ea0f3.name: My Will Be Done (Sautekh)
e96ca58ea0f3.plain: In your Command phase, this unit can choose one of your SAUTEKH CORE units that is within 9" of it. Add 1 to the hit roll of each attack made by a model in the chosen unit until your next Command phase begins. No unit can be chosen for this ability more than once per phase.

e9d5b5ec795c.name: Solar Fury
e9d5b5ec795c.plain: Models with this code add 3" to the Range characteristic of their ranged weapons, except Pistols. When a model with this code makes a ranged attack against a unit within half range, improve that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1. If all the units in your army (not counting DYNASTIC AGENT and C'TAN SHARD units) have this code, you can pick both directives of the Protocol of the Vengeful Stars, not just one, whenever it becomes active for your army.

ea2c8aedacd0.name: Phase Shifter
ea2c8aedacd0.plain: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

ea3a016325e0.name: Annihilation Protocols - Protocol of the Undying Gaze
ea3a016325e0.plain:
Directive 1: when a model in this unit makes a ranged attack against a unit within half range, the target gets no benefit from cover against that attack.
Directive 2: this unit can make ranged attacks while performing an action without the action failing.

eb193eb725ca.name: Command-wave Amplifier (Aura)
eb193eb725ca.plain: Aura: your SZAREKHAN units within 9" of the bearer get the active command protocol's selected directive within 9" (not 6") of a friendly NECRONS CHARACTER. C'TAN SHARD models don't count for this.

eb2faa5d1ff7.name: Annihilation Protocols - Protocol of the Swift Murder
eb2faa5d1ff7.plain:
Directive 1: if this unit did not Remain Stationary this battle round, it gets the benefits of light cover against every attack made against it.
Directive 2: this unit can perform Heroic Interventions as if it were a CHARACTER unit.

ec2016adad95.name: Self-destruction
ec2016adad95.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your CANOPTEK SCARAB SWARMS units is picked to fight: pick one model in it. Once that unit has finished piling in, you can pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of that model and roll a D6. On a 2-5, that enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, it takes 3 mortal wounds. That CANOPTEK SCARAB SWARM model is then destroyed.

eee817f96c0b.name: Grand Strategist
eee817f96c0b.plain: If your army is Battle-forged and you pick this model as your WARLORD, you get 2 extra Command points.

f0ad7ce918a0.name: Relentless March (Silent King) (Aura)
f0ad7ce918a0.plain: Aura: while one of your NECRONS CORE or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS units is within 6" of Szarekh, whenever that unit is picked to make a Normal Move or Advance, its models' Move characteristic goes up by 1" until the phase ends.

f10465352701.name: Command Protocols - Protocol of the Eternal Guardian
f10465352701.plain:
Directive 1: if this unit hasn't made a Normal Move, Advance or Fall Back this battle round, it has light cover against every attack made against it.
Directive 2: if no enemy units are within Engagement Range of this unit when an enemy unit declares a charge against it, this unit can choose to Hold Steady or Set to Defend:
- Hold Steady: until the end of the phase, Overwatch attacks by its models hit on unmodified rolls of 5+ instead of 6.
- Set to Defend: it can't fire Overwatch until the end of the phase, but until the next Fight phase ends, add 1 to the hit roll of each melee attack its models make.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"; the plain text leaves out the book reference

f16af1352d0c.name: Synthetic Cortex Enhancer (Aura)
f16af1352d0c.plain: Aura: your SZAREKHAN CORE units within 9" of the bearer get both directives of your army's active command protocol, not just the selected one.

f286e92eba6e.name: Illuminor
f286e92eba6e.plain: This model can use its Rites of Reanimation ability one extra time each turn.

f3cd55ca6b71.name: Arise Against the Interlopers
f3cd55ca6b71.plain: Melee attacks by models with this code against INFANTRY or BIKER units automatically wound on an unmodified hit roll of 6.

f6a4a2f2a53a.name: Empyric Overcharger (Aura)
f6a4a2f2a53a.plain: Aura: whenever a Psychic test is taken for an enemy PSYKER unit that is within 12" of this model, any double rolled on it, not only a double 1 or double 6, makes that unit suffer Perils of the Warp.

f6fa68609bdd.name: The Sovereign Coronal
f6fa68609bdd.plain: The bearer gets the Command-wave Amplifier (Aura) and Synthetic Cortex Enhancer (Aura) abilities.

f70f3dcee6f1.name: Translocation Crypt
f70f3dcee6f1.plain: Before the battle, when declaring reserves and transports (or during deployment, if your mission has no such step): pick one of your NEPHREKH units that is not a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit. It gains the Dimensional Translocation ability.

f7c44f1ddd9f.name: Eternal Conquerors
f7c44f1ddd9f.plain: Units with this code get the Objective Secured ability. If one of their models already has that ability, it counts as one extra model when working out who controls an objective marker.

f816c5901156.name: Phaeron
f816c5901156.plain: This model can use My Will Be Done one extra time each turn.

f83d446f04e9.name: Rad-Wreathed
f83d446f04e9.plain: Units with this code get the Rad-wreathed (Aura) ability.

f8ef03f0f33c.name: Artillery Battery
f8ef03f0f33c.plain: The first time this unit is set up on the battlefield, its models don't need to be in unit coherency; instead, every model must be set up within 6" of another model from its unit. From then on, treat each model in this unit as a separate unit.

f9a7b7135dd9.name: Immortal Pride
f9a7b7135dd9.plain: Whenever this WARLORD would lose a wound because of a mortal wound, roll one D6: on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound. This WARLORD also has the Immortal Pride (Aura) ability.

f9da11c592f9.name: Methodical Destruction
f9da11c592f9.plain: In your Shooting phase, once one of your SAUTEKH units has finished making its attacks: pick one enemy unit that a model in that SAUTEKH unit attacked this phase. Until the phase ends, add 1 to the hit roll whenever a model in a different SAUTEKH unit of yours attacks that enemy unit.

fa047206b1c3.name: Tomb Ziggurat Terrain Features
fa047206b1c3.plain: The Tomb Ziggurat counts as a terrain feature with the Scalable, Defensible, Light Cover and Obscuring terrain traits.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Rules"

fb045cc298d3.name: Storm of Flensing Blades
fb045cc298d3.plain: At the end of the Fight phase: pick one of your FLAYED ONES units that is within Engagement Range of any enemy units. It can fight again.

fb1379965e55.name: Inescapable Death
fb1379965e55.plain: Whenever this model makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the hit roll and Ballistic Skill, and the target doesn't get the benefits of cover against that attack. Also, when this model fires Overwatch, it hits on unmodified hit rolls of 2+ rather than 6.
